headline: August 2026 Monthly Release
summary: The Allstate Corporation (NYSE: ALL) today announced estimated catastrophe losses for the month of August of $748 million or $591 million, after-tax. Catastrophe losses for August include 21 events with approximately 50% of the losses related to one wind and hail event. Total catastrophe losses for July and August were $1.43 billion or $1.13 billion, after-tax.
